description: Variation of condition 3 ([a] detailed section drawings (scale 1:5) of existing and proposed flooring /floor build-up, including relationship between coverings and adjacent doors, architraves, skirting boards and railings; [b] detailed drawings showing all existing and proposed service runs; [c] a sample of glass to be used for new glass floor and roof over rear lightwell; [d] detailed elevation (scale 1:10) and section (scale 1:5) drawings of proposed doors and architraves; [e] detailed elevation (scale 1:10 or 1:20) and section (scale 1:5) drawings of proposed rear conservatory; [f] samples of stone paving to be used within rear lightwell) of listed building consent 18/08437 to allow repositioning of kitchen from rear outrigger to within front reception room.
